entities.name: Valšov–Rýmařov railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Valšov–Rýmařov railway is a commuter rail line in the Czech Republic. It was built and primarily operated by Imperial Royal Austrian State Railways (kkStB) as Staatsbahn Kriegsdorf–Römerstadt. It was divided from Bahnstrecke Olomouc–Opava východ at Valšov to the direction of Jeseník and Rýmařov.
